Signed Binary Notice • Why Windows SmartScreen Still Prompts Temporarily

100% Cryptographically Signed: Every official RaggieSoft Studio download—including Universal Web & Offline Setup.exe launchers, inner x64 & ARM64 .msi databases, Installer Studio v0.5.0, and Accessibility Studio v1.0.0—is Dual-Layer Authenticode-signed via Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing (Verified publisher: Michael Ragsdale, RFC 3161 timestamped, and verified with signtool verify /pa).

Why SmartScreen may still say “Windows protected your PC” right now: Our Microsoft Public Trust signing certificate is brand-new (issued November 25, 2026). Under Microsoft’s current SmartScreen rules, newly issued certificates start at zero download reputation until initial install volume and Microsoft Security Intelligence (WDSI) review complete (already submitted). To install safely while reputation clears: click More info, confirm Windows shows Publisher: Michael Ragsdale (never “Unknown publisher”), and click Run anyway. Full details in the FAQ →

28 Years in the Making (1998–2026) • Why I Built This

From Visual Basic 6.0 in 1998 to Zero-Bloat Win32 C++20

Ever since I started learning Visual Basic 6.0 back in 1998, I spent 28 years searching for the right Windows installation tool—shipping software across more than a dozen packaging engines spanning every era of Windows deployment: the limited-edition setup wizard bundled in the Visual Studio 6.0 box, classic procedural script installers, 3D-beveled commercial suites, interactive CD-ROM multimedia autorun builders (yes, at one point I even tried bending an autorun menu builder into an application installer!), lightweight open-source script packagers, and heavyweight enterprise MSI and XML toolchains.

Every Windows installer ultimately marshals calls down into the exact same msi.dll and cabinet.dll libraries Microsoft already ships inside C:\Windows\System32. Yet every tool I tried forced a painful tradeoff between multi-gigabyte IDE bloat, 32-bit legacy debt, opaque binary project files, steep XML boilerplate, or broken Windows 11 Dark Mode and screen-reader accessibility.

RaggieSoft Installer Studio takes everything those eras got right—plain-text diffable manifests, authentic relational .msi compliance, hierarchical tree editors, single-file LZMS solid compression, and classic-to-modern wizard ergonomics—and rebuilds it from first principles as original, MIT-licensed native Win32 C++20 software for x64 and ARM64.

Shipping Today in Technical Preview (v0.5.0)

  • 10 Era-Spanning Wizard Styles & Classic Setup Types: Switch from 1995 Microsoft ACME #008080 Teal (fullscreenteal), #000080 Cobalt Wash (fullscreenblue), & wizard95 through aerowizard & Windows 11 fluentmica step-rail—paired with Typical / Compact / Complete / Custom Setup Types, [Billboard.*] slides, and a live WCAG 2.2 AA Contrast Enforcer
  • Dual-Layer Microsoft Azure Artifact Signing & Universal Single-Download EXEs: Every inner C++20 binary, .msi database, Smart CPU-Aware Web Stub, and Combined Offline Universal EXE (x64 + ARM64) is Authenticode-signed with a verified Public Trust certificate
  • Plain-English Feature Inclusion Tiers & 12-View Tree-First IDE: Decide whether each feature belongs to a Minimal / Compact, Typical / Express, or Complete setup, edit RegEdit-style Registry & Dual Folder trees, and enjoy permanent Community == 100% Architect parity
  • 100% Dark-Mode-Complete UI, Native C++20 F1 Help & msiprism.exe: Live WM_SETTINGCHANGE(ImmersiveColorSet) palette hot-swapping, SPI_GETHIGHCONTRAST override, zero-dependency RaggieSoftHelp.exe, Pre-MSI runtimes, 64-bit .MSM merging, and --emit-vpat

Core Engineering Design Principles

The "Zero-Bloat" Architecture Matrix

Technical Architecture Goals for RaggieSoft Installer Studio
Design Pillar RaggieSoft Installer Studio Why It Matters
Toolchain Footprint Compact static /MT binaries (InstallerStudio.exe, instbuild.exe, SetupWizard.exe, msiprism.exe & RaggieSoftHelp.exe) Instant cold startup on local developer workstations and CI runners without multi-gigabyte framework installs.
Runtime Dependencies Zero third-party DLLs (System32\msi.dll, cabinet.dll, gdiplus.dll & Msftedit.dll only) Even the offline F1 Help Viewer runs natively in C++20 on stock Windows 11 (x64 & ARM64) with zero .NET or WebView2 requirements.
Tree-First Visual IDE 12 Views + 20 32-Bit ARGB Vector Tree Icons Dedicated Features, RegEdit Registry, Dual Folder, Runtimes, and Shortcuts trees with DarkMode_Explorer chevrons.
Windows Installer Rules ICE18, ICE38, ICE64 & ICE80 Enforced Validates Single-Directory Component rules, HKCU user-profile KeyPaths, CreateFolder, and 64-bit component attributes before msi.dll runs.
White-Label & Parity Community == Architect + 100% Author-Owned VERSIONINFO Community Edition enjoys full Architect feature parity across all 4 tiers (Community, Essentials, Developer, Architect), and compiled Setup.exe / .msi files carry your publisher identity with zero watermarks.
AI Agent Native --emit-ai-spec + --diagnostics=json Coding agents read deterministic /installer-studio/llms-full.txt and SKILL.md specs to write, lint, and compile installers from scratch.
